items.title: Skyblock Random Drops
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock, but with a twist! Start off in this skyblock world, but everytime you break a block, you never know what you will get! Can you defeat the Ender Dragon?

+Every drop is random!
+By FALL Studios & MatzX

items.title: Parkour
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Explore all the temple of the ancient civilization, you must survive, besides avoiding the different paths which will lead you to get the gem of power, with this gem you will dominate the temple and all the monsters will respect you.

Can you get it, or will you die trying?

- An ancient temple
- 3 different types of monsters
- By RareLoot

items.title: SCP Crash Site
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Mystery awaits deep in the woods! Uncover the secrets of the crashed alien spacecraft! A sci-fi survival adventure like no other is waiting for you!

- UFO survival spawn
- 4 alien skins
- Licensed under CC-BY-SA
- By RareLoot

items.title: Horror Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The stories they tell about the old mansion in the deep and dark woods are ones of pure horror! Creaky floors, long and dark hallways...do you dare to enter and explore or will you run and hide?

- Horror mansion
- Spooky forest
- By RareLoot

items.title: Halloween Secret Base
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Hide from trick-or-treaters in your new Halloween themed base hidden under a massive pumpkin! Climb down the hatch and explore all the base has to offer before venturing off to the nether and end.

+ Numerous rooms to explore
+ Nether and end portals in the base
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Halloween Parkour Dimensions
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Race your friends through all three dimensions as you parkour past spiders, skeletons, and ghosts! Any noob or pro will enjoy the journey to the top!

+ Overworld, Nether, and End dimensions
+ Playable alone or with friends
+ Great for beginners and pros
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Spooky Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Do you dare to stay the night in this haunted spooky mansion? Explore all the rooms in this three story mansion with enough space for all of your friends! Don't think you can last the night? Ride around until sunrise in your own vehicle!

+ 9 luxury vehicles
+ Over 25 rooms
+ Outdoor pool
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Craftable Villa
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Craft yourself your next luxury mansion! Choose from a total of 10 different villas and put them wherever you want. Feel free to choose the perfect location for your new home! Craft your own helicopter and take it for a spin or land it on your helicopter landing pad. 

+ 10 craftable mansions
+ Placeable villas
+ Craftable helicopter

Created by Mine-North

items.title: CREEPER REMASTERED V2
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Creepers are commonly green and stealthy until now…

11 HD (128px) skins including:

- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117
- 10 remastered Creepers

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Hostile Reimagined 2
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's time to take spookiness to the next level. Those monsters you know and love have been given another makeover by upping the creepiness to 11. Forget about zombies, become the snow golem or ravager you were meant to be!

- Includes 8 monster-themed skins
- A brand-new haul of reimagined horrors!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Control Bot AI
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Remember that itch on your back? It’s gone now, forever! 
With your brand new cyber body, there’s no need to worry. All those biological urges are a thing of the past! Enjoy your itch-free body and show off your new look to your friends. 

- 8 unique cyborg skins
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Legendary Texture Pack
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Become the legend you were meant to be! With a fresh take on armor trims, you can completely redefine your look!

- The finest 16x textures for building medieval & fantasy themes
- Complete armor overhaul with huge 3d geo additions
- Expressive mob redesign
- Vibrant items & detailed ui
- Includes 5 skins!
- 1.21 Chase the Skies ready

By Valerii Kim & Pathway Studios

items.title: Lucky Blocks Dogs
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Are you feeling fortunate? This giant dog park is full of random lucky blocks waiting to be opened! Pet and play with all of the cute dogs!

+ 450+ outcomes
+ A giant pet house
+ 10 different dogs!
+ Custom animations
+ 3 skins
+ Inspired by the original lucky block mod

items.title: Golem Town
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Beyond the tallest mountains and the farthest rivers, discover a mystical city--home to a gargantuan golem. Trees grow from its shoulders, moss hangs from its brow, and it casts a great shadow across the land. Are you brave enough to unearth the mysteries of Golem Town?
• 5 skins

items.title: Sphere Survival
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Challenge yourself to grow a world using only spheres of resources.

+ A challenging skyblock like experience!
+ See how far you can expand your world.

items.title: Flow Parkour
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description:
Like your parkour fast and smooth? Welcome to Flow Parkour! Run and jump your way through 13 beautiful levels alone or with friends!

- Multiplayer!
- 13 levels
- Realm friendly!

items.title: Space Run
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Trippy, fast-paced, thrilling. Three words to describe this manhunt mini-game. Can you catch all the Runners? Will you be fast enough? Will you be SMART enough?
Strengthen your nerves! Your heartbeat is about to go through the roof.

- Unlock all the characters by collecting Space Coins
- Play the game you want to play by choosing which options to enable
- Multiplayer only

items.title: Dune Warriors
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
You are the only protector of the dunes. Be the warrior of the desert and fight the sandy monsters!

+ 8 HD dune-themed skins!
+ Free skin: Ty
+ Dusty warriors

By FTB

items.title: Color City
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Take a walk through this city wearing your favorite color. This pack offers all the best colors. What will you wear?

items.title: Vamp Teens
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Come out at night to scare your friends. Put on these fashionable skins and go hunt with your fellow vampire friends!

+ 8 HD gothic skins!
+ Free skin: Benedict
+ Fashion, stylish & gothic inspired!

By FTB

items.title: Haunted Giant House
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: A giant house haunted by sinister trees and ghosts, come and adventure into it... or even live in! But be careful!

items.title: Cinders
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: Sometimes hot. Sometimes cold and sometimes just in between. Cinders have many stages to suit your needs.

items.title: Purple Mages
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: Of all the mage academia, the purple mages are by far the most stylish and powerful.

items.title: Wormhole Bandits
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: They are the bad boys from the wormhole clan.
